name: Dried Sê San anchovy
nameVi: Cá cơm khô sông Sê San
summary: A small river anchovy, washed and sun-dried, then fried with sour, spicy, salty, and sweet seasoning for rice. The 22 July 2022 tourism article gives the fish and two prices from the same landing.
origin: Residents of the Sê San, quoted by the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism on 22 July 2022, dry the fish as soon as it is caught. The fish is about 3–4 cm, with a translucent white body and an opaque white belly.
howToEat: Wash off the slime and dry it in the sun. In the rains, when it will not dry, the same landing ferments it into anchovy fish sauce instead.
The article’s rice plate is the dried fish fried golden, with sour, spicy, salty, and sweet seasoning, especially on a cold rainy day.
A salad of the same fish is a separate plate.
where: The Sê San landing, including the boat tour of the reservoir and Thác Mơ that returns to the pier for these plates. A Pleiku street is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: The 22 July 2022 article quotes 110,000 VND a kilogram for the dried fish. A current shop price is Check on arrival.
